summary: This Augustine lecture is already public Eschatology support for the Church outside history, while adding workflow-only pressure around self-negation as obedience, priestly redirection of grievance inward, and curiosity/imagination treated as sin.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Augustine takes the Catholic Church out of history, then makes obedience safer than ordinary historical action.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Eschatology page already carries this source through the stable institution-outside-history anchor, so no new public prose or episode-to-lens link is required in this compact intake.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this as the dated origin layer for the institution-outside-history mechanism. Rome's Christian end-of-history claim fails when Rome is sacked, and Augustine answers by moving the Church above ordinary historical failure while retaining power to authorize rulers and threaten hell.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns the sacred institution escaping history's test and governing present action through final safety and final threat. It should not become a generic Augustine, Catholic Church, Dark Ages, or Islam-origin page.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as earlier Augustine pressure for the obedience-renamed-freedom sequence: curiosity, exploration, intuition, imagination, love, and independent will are treated as dangers, while humility becomes self-denial, self-negation, and complete obedience.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Free Will owns the capture of agency itself. Eschatology owns the outside-history institution and hell threat; Bureaucracy owns office reproduction; Religion As Administrative Filter owns priestly doctrine and training.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold Augustine's priestly manual as administrative-filter pressure: City of God becomes repeatable training for priests who answer exploitation by redirecting the believer from external injustice toward internal sin and obedience.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Religion As Administrative Filter owns doctrine as operator training and interpretive code. This should be compared with Godhead, Paul, Church outside history, and later orthodoxy sources before public Christian-administration prose.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as bounded bureaucracy pressure where Jiang imagines Augustine as a lab-director of doctrine with scribes and priests turning theory into books, institutional authority, and mass-produced answers.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Bureaucracy owns institutional reproduction and office machinery, not the whole Augustine source. The central public mechanism remains Eschatology because the Church wins by escaping ordinary history.

concept_extensions.boundary_note: Reason As Replacement Religion owns later secular salvation substitutions. This source should not be used to collapse Augustine, communism, and modern reason into one undated public claim.

new_lens_seeds.title: Obedience Through Self-Negation
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: An institution can make obedience feel salvific by redefining the self as the problem: curiosity, imagination, love, and independent will become signs of sin, while humility means the self negates itself into command.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism can compare Augustine, Paul, Catholic orthodoxy, schooling, bureaucracy, AI obedience, and any order that tells people freedom begins when independent agency disappears.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed only. Do not create standalone Augustine, Original Sin, Self-Negation, Humility, Anti-Curiosity, Anti-Imagination, or Obedience Through Self-Negation pages from this source alone.

new_lens_seeds.title: Priestly Manual Redirects Grievance Inward
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A doctrine can become institutional training when priests answer exploitation by moving attention from external injustice to internal guilt, making the governed hunt the devil inside instead of the power acting outside.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism can compare Church, school, bureaucracy, therapy language, workplace discipline, and ideological systems that convert material grievance into personal defect.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a routing seed until multiple dated sources show the same grievance-to-guilt mechanism outside Augustine's Church.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2024-12-31, this is the earliest public-read layer for the current `eschatology-institution-outside-history` anchor: Augustine responds to the 410 sack of Rome by moving Church authority outside ordinary historical failure.

chronology_notes.concept: Free Will / Augustine before Paul-and-Dante compressions
chronology_notes.note: This older lecture supplies the direct Augustine formulation behind later Free Will language: complete freedom arrives when the will becomes the same as God's, which Jiang reads as complete obedience and self-negation.

chronology_notes.concept: Reason As Replacement Religion / revolutionary salvation template
chronology_notes.note: The communism comparison is a cross-historical analogy in this lecture: City of God supplies a template where present suffering and obedience are redeemed by later paradise. Keep this as dated comparison pressure, not a promoted secular-religion claim by itself.

The final Arabia bridge is a forward pointer to the next class: people who refuse Augustine's anti-curiosity and anti-imagination order go east, including to Arabia, where a revolutionary religion will challenge Church authority.
